app.title: Start the FileVault app
app.description: Install and start FileVault in Settings → Apps, then select Submit to find it. The custom integration must be installed and Home Assistant restarted first. Standalone installations can use the standalone service option instead.

hassio_confirm.title: Connect the FileVault app
hassio_confirm.description: Connect this app to Home Assistant? Connection credentials are exchanged privately through Supervisor. No token setup is needed.

standalone.title: Connect a standalone service
standalone.description: Enter the service origin and its integration credential. These details are needed only when the service runs outside the Home Assistant app. Never enter a Mac password here.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect the service
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the service origin and replacement credential. Home Assistant app connections normally obtain their credentials automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the FileVault service. Check that it is running and try again.
error.integration_required: This app connection needs an integration credential. Use the credential supplied by the FileVault app.
error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS origin without credentials, path, query, or fragment.
error.app_not_found: The FileVault app has not announced a connection. Install or start it, then try again.
error.supervisor_required: This Home Assistant installation does not manage apps. Connect a standalone service instead.
error.supervisor_unavailable: Cannot contact Home Assistant Supervisor. Try again after it is available.
error.multiple_apps: Several FileVault apps are available. Use the discovered integration card for the app you want.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one FileVault backend can be configured.
abort.invalid_discovery: The app announced incomplete or invalid connection details. Restart or update the app and try again.
abort.already_configured: This FileVault app is already connected.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This is a different app from the existing connection.
